intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nerelle reties the knot on a floating marker without looking at her hands.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “A sailor taught me this knot. He insisted his grandmother invented it.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Possibly. Six other grandmothers have made the same claim.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Two have written to the council. One enclosed a diagram and a threat.”

options.labelText: “Call it the grandmothers’ knot. All seven of them.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Seven signatories. That is more than our last trade agreement.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I will propose it. Through a very junior clerk, in case of diagrams.”

options.labelText: “Let’s settle it. Someone must have written down who tied it first.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Brave. I will tie something nice for your memorial.”
